text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of children enrolled in primary school
Comparing net and gross enrollment ratios for children in primary education. Net enrollment shows the share of
children of primary school age (typically 6–11 years) who are enrolled, while gross enrollment includes all
children regardless of age, expressed as a percentage of the population of the same age group.
